title.narrative: The ClimateShot Investor Coalition (CLIC) aims to rapidly scale-up the finance needed to shift to low-carbon, climate-resilient and nature-positive agriculture and food systems globally.

description.narrative: CPI holds the secretariat role. The Secretariat ensures day-to-day administrative management of the Coalition, including decision-making on routine matters, coordinating periodic meetings convened by the Coalition, engaging with external stakeholders to explore collaborations and strategic partnerships, as well as extending the membership base, formalizing and coordinating the membership application process, and administering funds including grant financials and narrative reporting.The Secretariat also provides thought leadership for the Coalition through its support to the Action Groups, the Agrifood Investment Connector – the Connector – and knowledge products. More widely, in acting as CLIC’s secretariat, CPI will be able to reflect our deep knowledge and understanding of the climate finance space and levels of development support focused in this area, thus being able to play a role in helping FCDO and other stakeholders to build potential synergies while avoiding duplication.

recipient-region.narrative: Currently concrete CLIC activities in investment facilitation are strongly focused on Sub-Sahara Africa. However, the secretariat is working on extending core partnerships to actors in developing economies and emerging markets in Asia and Latin America. The CLIC membership comprises organisations working across regions. Research products have a global reach beyond developing economies and emerging markets."

description.narrative: Continuous work on project activities, including knowledge products, the connector, delivery of one Action Group meeting.
